ops.text: c. for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, each Materials deliverable and Base Component provided under this Agreement will conform in all material respects to its applicable documentation and specifications, and will not contain any virus, worm or other malicious code. Customer's remedy for breach of the warranties in this Section 5.1 is, at IBM's option, re-performance of the non-conforming Services, repair or replacement of the non-conforming Materials or Base Component, or a refund of the charges paid for the non-conforming Services, Materials or Base Component.

ops.oldText: c. IBM PROVIDES ALL MATERIALS AND ALL NON-IBM SERVICES
ops.newText: c. EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY WARRANTED IN SECTION 5.1, IBM PROVIDES ALL MATERIALS AND ALL NON-IBM SERVICES

input.comment: [Playbook] We added a 90-day conformance warranty for Materials and Base Components with a repair, replace, re-perform or refund remedy, and carved the express warranties out of the "AS IS" disclaimer, since Section 5.1 currently gives no conformance warranty or remedy for non-conforming work. Our playbook position is 12 months for software and 90 days for services deliverables; 90 days here is our fallback and we can work with it.
input.summary: Add 90-day conformance warranty, no-malicious-code warranty and a repair/replace/re-perform/refund remedy; carve express warranties out of the AS IS disclaimer.
